name: tenants_planning_rules
description: List the Team Planning rules a plan may set. Each gives its description, value_schema (the shape of its value), built_in_default, and the active tenant's own tenant_default with who set it and when, or null where the tenant hasn't set one. A plan follows the tenant default, else the built-in one, until it sets the rule itself. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
